notes: SPC --for-extensions names (without ext- prefix). Extension list is a deliberate SFX superset (transitive micro/build needs: sodium/dom/simplexml/xmlreader/xmlwriter/zlib/pdo/sqlite3) — not identical to system-PHAR Composer/bin/console/installer guards (see docs/phar-packaging.md). Core pins: exact PHP patch + official source SHA-256 + immutable phpmicro commit via --custom-local=php-micro. Libraries beyond PHP/phpmicro are not fully locked. Host static builds need re2c/flex/gperf. User guide: docs/static-packaging.md.
